podcast.title: Project Revolution Performer (2004)
podcast.body: The Uses performed at Project Revolution in 2004, when the tour expanded into a two-stage affair featuring ten acts. "and the Uses."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Contribution to Screamo Evolution
podcast.body: The Used were among the bands credited with contributing significantly to the evolution of Screamo, a darker, louder, and more intense form of emo music. "Groups like the used...all contributed to the evolution of Screamo."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Contribution to Screamo Evolution
xref.body: The Refused were among the groups that played a role in the development and evolution of Screamo, a subgenre characterized by its darker, louder, and more intense sound. "Groups like the used, the refused...all contributed to the evolution of Screamo."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Contribution to Screamo Evolution
xref.body: Hawthorne Heights were listed as one of the bands that contributed to the overall evolution of Screamo, a more intense and politically aware offshoot of emo. "Groups like the used...Hawthorne Heights under oath...all contributed to the evolution of Screamo."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Contribution to Screamo Evolution
xref.body: Underoath was mentioned as one of the bands that helped shape the evolution of Screamo, a darker, louder, and more intense style of emo music. "Groups like the used...under oath...all contributed to the evolution of Screamo."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Contribution to Screamo Evolution
xref.body: At The Drive-In played a part in the development of Screamo, a genre noted for its darker, louder sound and political themes. "Groups like the used...and at the drive-in all contributed to the evolution of Screamo."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: High School Band Engagements
xref.body: During his mid-teens, while still in high school, Jay performed with punk bands like The Used and The Bouncing Souls, followed by stints in metal bands Chaosus and Sadie May. "By the time he was in his middle teens, Jay was gigging with punk bands like The Used in the Bouncing Souls."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
